hypothesis_evidence.interpretation: Packaging succeeded; local predictions/semantic code changed, but evidence does not show corrected full rules, useful repairs or net score.

recommendation: Do not scale or formally submit v5 and do not launch another full diagnostic with insufficient quota. Retain the two narrow task-pixel matches as mechanism evidence. The next single research problem should be object-domain grounding: distinguish interactive objects from legend/HUD and predict their real extent before rule-discriminating actions. This is directly shared by ft09 UI clicks and su15 legend/mover merging; adding another generic delivery/context toggle or only repairing the su15 index does not address it. Prepare an offline evidence-driven design first, not another module stack.
